detail.title: 一种龙门滑轮升降抓取装置
detail.abstract: The invention discloses a crane pulley lifting grabbing device. The crane pulley lifting grabbing device comprises a portal bracket, wherein the bottom ends of upright posts of the portal bracket are fixedly mounted on the ground; a through groove is formed in the upper surface of a beam of the portal bracket in the length direction; grooves with the same length of the through groove are formed in the positions, on the upper surface of the beam, on the two sides of the through groove; a sliding transportation mechanism is mounted inside the grooves; a pulley lifting rotating mechanism is fixedly mounted at the lower end of the sliding transportation mechanism; a multi-arm pneumatic sucking disc clamping mechanism is fixedly mounted below the pulley lifting rotating mechanism; a controller is arranged on the surface of one of the upright posts of the portal bracket; and the controller is electrically connected with the sliding transportation mechanism, the pulley lifting rotating mechanism and the multi-arm pneumatic sucking disc clamping mechanism. The crane pulley lifting grabbing device has the beneficial effects that the structure is simple, and the practicability is high.
